programs.name: degree_reward
programs.rationale: Trades root reward against active conflict count. Uses native local information with no added feature computation; unequal rival weights and mutual conflicts remain unmodeled.

programs.name: turnaround_weight_pressure
programs.rationale: Balances reward against aggregate active rival weight and continuous turnaround occupancy. Uses native root and neighborhood inputs without added features; summed rival weight can overstate competing opportunity.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) * (1 + duration) / (1 + duration + 0.25 * (station_gap + satellite_gap))

programs.name: local_density_discount
programs.rationale: Discounts aggregate rival pressure when active neighbors conflict among themselves, while retaining the strongest rival as a floor. Local induced-edge computation can be quadratic in active degree.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 2 * neighbor_edges / max(1, degree))) / (1 + weight))

programs.name: weighted_overlap_margin
programs.rationale: Uses weighted mutual exclusion among active rivals to estimate displaced reward, then scores a signed root margin with a small sparsity bonus. The approximation is local; weighted induced-edge work can be quadratic.
programs.rule: weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 2 * overlap_mass / (1 + conflict_weight))) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + degree)

programs.name: local_greedy_switch
programs.rationale: Separates favorable comparisons with a feasible packing of active rivals from normalized shortfalls. This local threshold is heuristic; constructing the greedy packing can be costly at high degree.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + neighbor_pack) if weight >= neighbor_pack else (weight - neighbor_pack) / (1 + weight + neighbor_pack)

programs.name: local_bound_caution
programs.rationale: Scores a normalized margin against a neighborhood cover estimate and penalizes disagreement with feasible greedy packing. Its reach stays local, but computing both estimates may consume substantial time.
programs.rule: (weight - neighbor_cover) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) - 0.1 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_pack) / (1 + neighbor_cover) + 0.05 * weight / ((1 + weight) * (1 + degree))

programs.name: compatible_pair_lookahead
programs.rationale: Combines root reward with its heaviest active compatible contact and subtracts average local rival pressure. This global two-contact horizon omits longer interactions and requires residual filtering and scanning per candidate.

programs.name: residual_greedy_completion
programs.rationale: Estimates completion reward by fixing the root and greedily packing the entire compatible active residual. This gives global structural reach, but repeated root-conditioned packing may dominate the full solve budget.
